input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 contains a Vendor insurance clause that meets the preferred position in full: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, E&O of USD 2M, and cyber/privacy liability of USD 5M (Vendor processes Customer Data as a hosting provider), maintained at Vendor's expense for the term plus one year, with employer's liability of USD 1M as an extra. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, primacy over Customer's insurance, notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. No redline required.
